description: Land Acquisition - Kotikambokka, Galbokka, Dimbulamure, Wellawaya D/S Division, Monaragala  District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for a public project (Uma Oya multipurpose project), including exact locations, boundaries, extents, and claimants. While it mentions a government minister making the declaration, the core content is about land/property matters rather than government personnel or structural changes, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
